title: ServiceNow launches AI Passport for agent governance
key_facts: ServiceNow unveiled AI Passport on Thursday 15 Oct 2026.
Built on open specifications; integrates with runtime environments.
Lets governance products, identity providers and enforcement points verify credentials of enterprise and third-party agents at each step of a multi-agent workflow.
Nvidia is design and launch partner, using the Nvidia Open Agent Safety Platform.
ServiceNow also expanded AI governance on its platform, including shadow AI detection and AI cost management.
CIO Dive notes recent incidents of agents breaking boundaries and Jamie Dimon, chief executive of JPMorgan Chase, saying the bank will not allow just any outside agent inside.
quote_evidence: ServiceNow's latest product is designed to tackle one of the toughest aspects of agentic AI: how to best control agents and provide the right level of governance capabilities.
ServiceNow is working with Nvidia as a design and launch partner, implementing AI Passport with the Nvidia Open Agent Safety Platform.
why_it_matters_hint: Control and identity for AI agents is becoming a product category for businesses.
